caption:
# GUI Interface Description

## Desktop Environment
- **Operating System**: Linux (Ubuntu-based, judging by the interface and application icons)
- **Desktop Shell**: GNOME 3 (based on the window manager, application dock, and file manager design)
- **Wallpaper**: Abstract geometric pattern with gradient from deep purple to red-orange
- **Top Bar**: Black bar at the top of the screen
  - Left: "Activities" button
  - Center: "Terminal" label indicating the active application
  - Right: System indicators including date/time ("Oct 22 23:24"), notification bell, and system status icons (network, sound, power)

## Application Windows

### File Manager (Nautilus)
- **Window Title**: "Home"
- **Location**: Left side of the screen, overlapping slightly with the terminal window
- **Layout**: Two-pane interface
  - **Left Pane (Navigation)**:
    - "Recent" section with clock icon
    - "Starred" section with star icon
    - "Home" section with house icon (currently selected, highlighted in gray)
    - "Desktop", "Documents", "Downloads", "Music", "Pictures", "Videos", "Trash" (standard locations)
    - "Other Locations" with plus icon
  - **Right Pane (Content)**:
    - Grid view of files and folders
    - **Visible Folders**:
      - Desktop, Documents, Downloads, Music, Pictures, Public
      - server, snap, Templates, Videos
      - .cache, .config, .gnupg, .ipython, .lessht, .local, .mozilla
      - .pki, .profile, .selected_editor, .ssh, .sudo_as_admin_successful, thunderbird, .var
      - .viminfo, .vscode
    - **Visible Files**:
      - requirements.txt
      - .bash_history, .bash_logout, .bashrc
- **Toolbar**:
  - Back and forward navigation buttons
  - Home button with house icon
  - More options button (three dots)
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - View options (list, grid, etc.) with dropdown
  - Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)

### Terminal (GNOME Terminal)
- **Window Title**: "user@user-virtual-machine: ~"
- **Location**: Right side of the screen, partially overlapping the file manager
- **Appearance**:
  - Dark purple background
  - Light-colored text (white or light gray)
  - Prompt: "user@user-virtual-machine:~$"
  - Cursor: Blinking vertical bar (I-beam) at the end of the prompt
- **Toolbar**:
  - Terminal icon (green square with white terminal symbol)
  - Search icon (magnifying glass)
  - Menu button (three horizontal lines)
  - Window control buttons (minimize, maximize, close)
- **Content**: Empty command line, ready for input

## Dock (Left Sidebar)
- **Application Icons** (top to bottom):
  - Google Chrome
  - Thunderbird (email client)
  - Visual Studio Code
  - VLC Media Player
  - LibreOffice Writer
  - LibreOffice Calc
  - LibreOffice Impress
  - GIMP (image editor)
  - Ubuntu Software (orange shopping bag icon)
  - Help (blue question mark)
  - Terminal (black square with white command prompt)
  - Trash (green recycle bin)
- **Bottom of Dock**:
  - App Grid (9x9 grid of dots)

## Desktop Icons
- **Single Icon**:
  - "Home" folder icon (gray folder with house symbol) located at the bottom right corner of the screen

## System Status
- **No visible system notifications or alerts**
- **No active applications or processes indicated in the top bar**
